content.title: Service Transformation | Private Craft, Dual Fit Proof, Public Return
content.summary: Introduce an adult client with a visible deficiency inside a professional service space. Show specialist assessment and at least two attributable interventions, preserve client identity through staged transformation, require both professional verification and client self-adjustment, then return to public movement and observer response as functional proof.

quick_start.input_format: adult client's visible deficient baseline + professional service space and specialist + assessment and at least two visible tools or manual interventions + identity-registered staged transformation + professional verification and client self-adjustment + public functional and observer proof
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult bicycle courier enters a gear-repair studio with a rain-torn sagging harness. An adult technician measures load points, removes damaged webbing and installs reflective straps plus stable buckles in registered stages; after technician and courier fit checks, the courier rides upright outside and another adult rider gives one restrained approving nod.
required_anchors: Establish an adult client's visible baseline problem inside or immediately before a professional service space.
Show specialist assessment plus at least two visible tools or manual interventions.
Include professional fit verification and one self-directed client adjustment.
Return to a public context where posture, movement and at least one observer response register the change.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Introduce an adult client with a visible deficiency inside a professional service space. Show specialist assessment and at least two attributable interventions, preserve client identity through staged transformation, require both professional verification and client self-adjustment, then return to public movement and observer response as functional proof.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Introduce one adult client with a visibly inadequate, damaged or misfitting state and bring them into a clearly defined professional service space. Show the specialist assessing the problem and using at least two visible tools or manual interventions. Preserve the client's identity and body registration through a staged transformation. Require both professional fit verification and one self-directed adjustment by the client, then return the client to a public context where changed posture, movement and observer response prove the result. The reusable mechanism is deficient baseline, professional assessment, attributable craft, identity-preserving transformation, dual fit confirmation and public return—not the source animated characters, body proportions, ragged coat, tailor, shop, red thread, pin, navy suit, street crowd, exact action, studio style, creator identity or model claim.

invariants.rule: Establish an adult client's visible baseline problem inside or immediately before a professional service space.
invariants.purpose: Defines what the service must change.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unproven problem makes the makeover ornamental.

invariants.rule: Show specialist assessment plus at least two visible tools or manual interventions.
invariants.purpose: Attributes the outcome to professional craft.
invariants.ablation_failure: A magical cut without process removes service causality.

invariants.rule: Preserve client identity and body registration through a staged transformation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the body or angle breaks continuity.

invariants.rule: Include professional fit verification and one self-directed client adjustment.
invariants.purpose: Proves both external quality and internal acceptance.

invariants.rule: Return to a public context where posture, movement and at least one observer response register the change.
invariants.purpose: Converts private craft into functional and social payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending in the workshop withholds consequence.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source animated giant client, small tailor, facial identities, proportions and costume designs
the source ragged coat, red thread, pins, shirt, navy suit, vest, tie and exact transformation actions
the source tailor shop, fabric shelves, street crowd, architecture, framing and lighting
the source spinning choreography, reaction poses, lapel adjustments, exit gait and observer arrangement
the source creator identity, Seedance/GPT claim, animation-studio look, platform overlay, watermark and branding
